activity.role: Submarine brigade chief of staff aboard B-59
activity.notes: The U.S. National Security Archive documents that on 27 October 1962, during the Cuban Missile Crisis, Vasily Arkhipov was the Soviet submarine brigade chief of staff aboard B-59 and helped Captain Valentin Savitsky avoid launching a nuclear torpedo. ATLAS records the exact incident day and does not encode the counterfactual claim that one individual certainly prevented a world war.

sources.title: Soviet Submarines, Nuclear Torpedoes, and the Cuban Missile Crisis - National Security Archive
sources.citation_text: The National Security Archive documents Arkhipov's role aboard B-59 on 27 October 1962 and his part in avoiding a nuclear-torpedo launch decision.
